newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 1.16 points to 6,304.87. PLDT's ADR dropped by $0 1/2 to $57 3/4.
* On Friday, the peso closed at 26.297 to a U.S. dollar from 26.298.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,120.20, down 8.91.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was at 10.8125 from 11.0625 pct.

* Indicating renewed confidence in the country's credit-worthiness, the Japanese government has agreed to slash from 35 percent to a mere 1 percent its loan loss provision requirement for Japanese banks that have lent to Philippine banks (TODAY).

* The Philippine national inflation rate is likely to settle at an average of 9 percent by yearend, higher than the 8.7 percent revised inflation rate programmed by government economic managers, a report by the Hongkong Shanghai Banking Corp said (BUSINESS DAILY).
* President Fidel Ramos may finally make it today to grant a self-regulatory status to the Philippine Stock Exchange and to hand the license to operate to the Philippine Central Depository Inc.
